title: Unattributed identifiers
description: Identifiers and URLs observed in the Translator platform that have not been attributed to a component in components/. A holding pen, not a component: entries leave it by being promoted into a component file or by being confirmed out of use.

otel_services.description: OpenTelemetry service names seen in a Jaeger collector that no components/*.yaml claims.

helm_charts.description: Chart directories in helxplatform/translator-devops/helm that no components/*.yaml claims.

urls.description: URLs seen in the wild that no component claims.

name.description: The identifier exactly as it appears at the source.

status.description: unattributed: we do not know what this is. operation: a processing step reported as its own service, not a component. not-recorded: it is a known component that has no file yet, named by `component`. not-in-use: confirmed retired, kept so it is not investigated twice.

first_seen.description: ISO date this identifier was first observed. Quote it: YAML would otherwise parse a bare date into a date object, which is not a JSON Schema string.

environments.description: Which environments it was observed in.

component.description: The component id this belongs to, once known — for a chart, the component it deploys. Required by `not-recorded`; on an `unattributed` entry it is a guess and must be read alongside `evidence`.

evidence.description: How we know what we think we know. Say what was observed, not what was assumed.
